_doc: Visible facial landmarks read by eye on the identified original plate. Coordinates are in the crop; sigma includes screening and occlusion. No hidden far eye is invented.
age_note: Undated portrait; age is an approximate modelling estimate from the period of the plate. Scene age uses the separately sourced birth date. The printed presidency year for Keith is not a photographic date.
basis: Identified caption/signature and biographical entry, plate facing p. 461. A single-view facial fit, with loose uncertainties for obscured features; the image identity is attested but unseen form is reconstructed.
not_modelled: Exact photographic date; skin, eye and clothing colours; height and build below the bust.

card._doc: What the person's card shows (T-3413): `portrait` is cut from the scan at `portrait_from_scan_px` (left, top, right, bottom) and scaled to `size_px`; `model` is tools/portrait_still.mjs's render of the fitted face on `body`, turned to the fit's yaw and framed like the portrait. `dress` (T-3440): the still is dressed as humans.js dresses him in town, with his skin, his own hair and moustache (human-hair-styles.js) and his spectacles (human-spectacles.js). `hide` leaves out his derby: the portrait is bareheaded.
